queries: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(spent / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_spend_ratio, 0) AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(1.0 * spent / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT er.event_id, er.spend_ratio, er.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS er CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_spend_ratio, 0) AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio IS NULL, relative_spend_ratio DESC, e.event_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A budget line with a zero amount has an undefined ratio and is excluded from the event average, as are lines with missing spent or amount values. A missing event id does not identify an event.

responses.sql: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(1.0 * spent / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT er.event_id, er.spend_ratio, er.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS er CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A budget line with a missing spent or amount value, or a zero amount, has no defined ratio. An event with no defined line ratios has a missing spend ratio and is excluded from the overall AVG.

responses.sql: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_spend_ratio, 0) AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio IS NULL, relative_spend_ratio DESC, e.event_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A budget line with a zero amount has no defined spend ratio, so its ratio is treated as missing. If the overall average is zero, relative figures are also treated as missing.
